jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: Field alignment is strong (human rights, strategic litigation aligns with candidate's international law and justice interests), but this is a Manager-level role in the Reprieve pay band requiring substantial litigation and management experience the candidate lacks. Likely also requires legal qualification for strategic litigation leadership. Hard ineligibility on seniority.
jobs.salary: £52,088 plus up to 5% employee matched pension contribution

jobs.title: Senior Digital Forensics Consultant
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility on seniority — the role requires a minimum of 8 years of professional experience plus expert-witness capability and deep specialist digital forensics tooling (Cellebrite, AXIOM, X-Ways, FTK), none of which the candidate has. While S-RM is a target firm in the commercial intelligence zone, this is a senior technical specialist position far beyond the candidate's stage.

jobs.title: Policy Fellow – Bloomberg LSE Mayoral Strategic Authorities Programme
jobs.reason: This is a senior Policy Fellow role requiring substantial experience leading projects in public policy/government, designing executive education, and deep expertise in UK local government and devolution — well beyond the candidate's MSc-in-progress stage and student-assistant experience. The field (UK domestic devolution and city governance) is also adjacent rather than core to the candidate's IR/international law focus. Hard ineligibility on seniority.
